title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2004
notes: The title screen waits for key 5. The logos and legal screens before it take about a minute and a half.
To swing: hold Down to pull the club back, then press Up. Key 5 switches between the swing view and the plan view, where you aim and pick the club.
The left soft key pauses a round (resume, options, scorecard, quit).
Arena on the main menu is N-Gage Arena, Nokia's online service, which no longer exists. One golfer is unlocked only through it.
The game can remap its own keys under Options > Control Options, on top of the bindings here.

controls.source: The game's defaults, read from its Options > Control Options screens (Swing, Plan and Flight controls). The swing, the plan view toggle, aiming, the pause menu and menu keys were also tried in play.

actions.up: Swing: hit the ball. Plan view: aim farther. Ball in flight: spin up
actions.down: Swing: pull back. Plan view: aim nearer. Ball in flight: spin down
actions.left: Swing: draw. Plan view: aim left. Ball in flight: spin left
actions.right: Swing: fade. Plan view: aim right. Ball in flight: spin right
actions.5: Switch between swing view and plan view; select in menus, start from the title
actions.1: Swing: power boost. Plan view: less club. Ball in flight: increase spin
actions.3: Swing: power boost. Plan view: more club. Ball in flight: increase spin
actions.lsk: Pause menu in a round; the left option in menus (Select, Done, Edit)
actions.rsk: The right option in menus (Back, Cancel)

statusNote: Runs from the logos through the main menu into a practice round: the first hole at Bay Hill is drawn in 3D, and the plan view, the swing and the ball flight all work.
